title: pilosella ericetorum
intro: Pilosella ericetorum, commonly known as Roseroot or Mountain Avens, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family, native to Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to improve cognitive function, boost energy, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Pilosella ericetorum include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and adaptogenic properties, making it a popular ingredient in herbal remedies for stress relief and mental clarity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include triterpene saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
